The '''Twin Suns''' was an interstellar [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group active on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Named after the [[Tatoo system/Legends|system's]] [[Binary star/Legends|twin]] [[Star/Legends|suns]] [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]], it was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The group had operations in [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], racketeering, and other criminal areas.
